annotations.title: What is left to set up for an account

description: The setup card for one account: four rows (Niche, Who it's for, Sounds, Skips), each with the best guess so far and whether it is settled, and a question for every row that is not (up to 20, in the order to ask). Call it after setup_run; fill the rows you can from captions and voice_get, and ask the person only what is left, all in one message. same_as names another account that is already set up; preselect true means it cross-posts at least half the same captions. Without account_id, the first account with an open row.

account_id.description: The account. Omit for the first account with an open row

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
